purpose: FROZEN pre-declared search space for the R2-4 benchmark-relative strategy selection. Enumerates EVERY degree of freedom so the Deflated-Sharpe / PBO multiple-testing correction uses the cumulative trial count N — not a flattering survivor subset. The search (round2_search.py) reads this, asserts the carry-factor order, runs all N candidates on the inner train/val split (never test), and selects the SINGLE strategy carried into R2-5 freeze + R2-6 verdict. Editing this after a search run voids the deflation — re-declare and re-run.
carry_factor_order_note: Positional order the Sobol weight vectors map to; MUST equal benchmark_relative.CARRY_FACTORS or the search fails closed (mirrors weight_search.EXPECTED_FACTOR_ORDER). Composite consumes each factor's industry/size-neutralized *_neut column.

exposure_constraint.note: The R2-3 small-cap-drift fix is the primary DOF. unconstrained = the R2-3 construction (size active -0.67); constituent_only = true enhanced-index (tilt only CSI300 members); size_neutral = remove the active vector's size projection; capped_nonconstituent = cap non-member gross active at nonconst_cap.

nonconst_cap.note: Fixed; only applies when exposure_constraint == capped_nonconstituent.

weight_simplex.anchor_note: Each (constraint,k,a_max) cell prepends the equal-weight carry vector (the R2-3 illustrative composite) before the 16 Sobol simplex points → 17 weight vectors per cell.

search_design.n_trials_note: 36 cells x 17 weight vectors = 612 candidates. This is the pre-declared N for DSR/PBO deflation (cumulative, not survivor-only). Recorded into the search result as dsr n_trials.

selection.metric_note: Per-period excess-vs-CSI300 Sharpe (annualised IR). Score every candidate on inner-train IR, shortlist the train-robust top-k, pick the unique winner = best inner-val IR (round-1 _select cross-validation discipline).

disclosure.dsr_note: MAIN statistical gate, deflated by n_trials_total. PBO <=0.5 hard / <=0.2 target. SPA vs three baselines: passive CSI300 (zero active), round-1 frozen strategy excess, momentum incumbent excess. Sentinel = shuffled-composite control candidates batched in. Mechanism gate: all carry factors are registry-mechanism-backed.

honesty.verdict_boundary: This search produces DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE + the single selected strategy ONLY — never a PASS/FAIL. The four-gate verdict is R2-6 on the locked test set (one shot, strategy frozen first).
honesty.failed_or_aborted_note: Variants considered then dropped during development BEFORE this declaration count toward N. None dropped: all four exposure_constraints are kept and searched (size_neutral retained despite being weak on the train_val grid, for honest completeness). Any variant pruned AFTER a real run that informs re-design must be added here and N re-deflated.
honesty.test_reuse: Per docs/research/factor-strategy-round2-test-reuse-decision-2026-06-19.md: train_val reused across experiments is allowed; test stays sealed until the R2-6 one-shot.
